title Villa Aliso - warm, slow, nostalgic: a plucked lullaby in G major; the round ends on a shimmering chord and starts again (16 bars)
tempo 88
vol 235
meter 4/4
inst soft v=200,255,235,215,200,190,180
inst held att=2 vib=1 vdelay=10 vper=16 slow lvl=0.9
inst chime arp=0,4,7 rate=2 lvl=0.8
inst drop drum=g7 v=170,140,95,50 d=0,-10,-26,-50
l4
@soft
# --- A: the lullaby (G Em C D, G Em Am D)
o5 g b o6 d e8 d8 |
o5 b4. a8 g4 e4 |
o5 e g o6 c d8 c8 |
o5 b a f+ r!drop |
o5 g b o6 d g |
o6 e4. d8 o5 b4 g4 |
o5 a o6 c e d |
o5 b a @held g2 @soft |
# --- B: the same tune looks up (C G Am D)
o6 c e g e |
o5 b o6 d @held g2 @soft |
o5 a o6 c e c |
o6 d c o5 b a |
# --- A again, and the last chord shimmers
o5 g b o6 d e8 d8 |
o5 b4. a8 g4 e4 |
o5 a o6 c e d |
o5 b a @chime g2 @soft |
